d:
When Mr Bean’s picnic sandwiches get eaten by pigeons, he heads to the supermarket to
replace them. Only the parent and child parking bays are free, so he parks there and
pretends that Teddy is a baby in a blanket, plonking him in a trolley. But once in the
shop, he gets the trollies mixed up and ends up with a real baby! Can he switch the baby
and Teddy back before he’s found out?
